about: Lab photos (Wikimedia Commons, licenses in evals/datasheets/photos.md) with the tags a mapper would draft. must = tags that should appear; may = tags that are fine either way. Images are read from lab/data/photos, not copied. v2 adds six: one lit fountain and five scenes with no allow-listed feature, which test that nothing is invented (no names from signs).

items.note: picnic table: leisure=picnic_table is off the list, so nothing is required
basketball court: no allow-listed feature is required
decorative fountains at night; amenity=fountain is right but not required
playground: leisure=playground is off the list
shopping cart in a parking lot: nothing to tag
mall entrance with a sign: the name on the sign must never appear
